input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: No transition-assistance or data-return clause exists anywhere in this hosting agreement. Section 14 (p0079) merely continues services to month-end after notice, and Section 13 (p0078) puts the burden on Client to arrange a new name server (30 days) and new hosting environment (60 days) with no TrueLink duty to assist migration, return or export data, or delete and certify deletion; sec-10 has no return-of-materials hook. That falls short of even the fallback, so we insert the preferred transition clause after the Termination section (it falls within the "Sections 1 and 5 through 30" survival language in p0090).

ops.text: 14a. TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF DATA. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide transition assistance for up to 6 months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after such expiry or termination; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanics, so we have added a transition clause requiring up to 6 months' assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, return of data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion after the Termination section
